# v5.0.0 — Module 5: Forward and Reverse Logistics

Adds the complete release-audited Module 5 built around fictional HarborPeak Equipment Systems.

- logistics strategy, warehousing, materials handling, fulfillment, distribution networks, transportation, and carrier selection

- 16 fictional CSV datasets

- logistics/trade/reverse-flow formula and control sheet
- HarborPeak integrated network/trade/reverse-flow capstone and worked solution
